October 5, 2026. New, separately funded run: the controller checked actual allowance, expiry, reserve and gas before each task. Qwen produced the first two results. After a real process exit following the second signed send, Llama reused the saved result, reconciled the same payment signature and completed the third task after finality. The independent verifier checked finalized signed bytes, each result Memo and exact token deltas. A second concurrent CLI runner was refused before inference or signing.
Eight finalized transactions in this run, including excess refund, setup, three settlements, revoke and two returns. Total BATTERY network fees: 0.00004 SOL. Test payments went to the owned worker; they are not provider invoices or project revenue. Local inference, prefunded SOL and one trusted operator; hosted paid service and automatic gas refill remain absent.

October 5, 2026. A bounded financial experiment on Solana mainnet. Three 0.01 USDC settlements bind saved owned-agent results. The second transfer survived a deliberate process exit; replay created no new payment. All principal returned.
Inference ran locally before settlement. These transfers are test settlements to our own worker, not model-provider bills. The hosted paid-service release remains on hold.

The 5,000 lamports shown on each receipt are the network fee. Each research payment also transferred 0.01 USDC via the existing fixed-delegation program. Its Memo binds a result hash; the Memo itself is not the money transfer.
